security_audit.summary: Most Markdown code fence detections are false positives. Confirmed risks include a pipe-to-shell installer, several external CLI examples, and one hardcoded installer URL. No prompt injection or additional semantic abuse was found.

remediation.suggestion: Replace curl piped to sh with manual download, checksum verification, and a separate install command that users can inspect first.

remediation.issue: External CLI commands that call hosted services
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running infsh commands and explain what product data may be sent to external services.
Present npx install commands as optional manual steps and advise users to review package sources before installation.

content.value_statement: Product Hunt launches need clear assets, timing, and fast engagement. This skill turns launch details into practical guidance for listings, galleries, comments, and launch day work.
actual_capabilities: Summarizes Product Hunt listing specs, including tagline, description, topics, makers, and gallery limits.
Recommends gallery image order, dimensions, and content goals for product launches.
Provides tagline formulas and examples with the 60 character limit.
Outlines launch timing, launch day actions, and comment engagement rules.
Supplies maker comment structure and a sample comment for launch posts.
Includes optional inference.sh commands for image generation and launch research.
limitations: Does not publish products, manage accounts, or automate Product Hunt actions.
Product Hunt rules and interface details can change after the skill was written.
Optional image and research commands require inference.sh access and may send data to external services.
Cannot guarantee ranking, upvotes, press coverage, or conversions.

use_cases.title: First Product Hunt Launch
use_cases.description: A founder can prepare a concise listing, gallery plan, and launch day checklist before submission.

use_cases.title: Gallery Asset Planning
use_cases.description: A marketer can map five launch visuals to product value, features, proof, and differentiation.

use_cases.title: Launch Day Coordination
use_cases.description: A maker team can align timing, maker comments, replies, and follow-up tasks for the full launch day.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Launch Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a Product Hunt launch checklist for [product]. Include listing fields, gallery assets, timing, and maker comment tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Improve My Tagline
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these Product Hunt taglines for [product]. Keep each under 60 characters and explain which one is clearest.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Gallery Images
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a five-image Product Hunt gallery for [product]. Describe the goal, visual concept, and message for each image.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Full Launch Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a two-week Product Hunt launch plan for [product]. Include research, assets, outreach, launch day timeline, and post-launch follow-up.

output_examples.input: Prepare a launch plan for a developer analytics tool.
output_examples.output: A launch checklist with listing specs, five gallery images, a maker comment outline, and a launch day timeline.

output_examples.input: Review three taglines for an AI documentation product.
output_examples.output: A ranked tagline review that checks clarity, benefit, and the 60 character Product Hunt limit.

output_examples.input: Plan gallery images for a customer feedback app.
output: Hero image shows the dashboard and core value.
Second image explains the feedback workflow.
Third image compares before and after customer insights.

best_practices: Confirm current Product Hunt rules before launch day.
Use real product screens in the first gallery image.
Reply to every useful comment with specific answers.
anti_patterns: Using generic visuals that hide the product.
Launching without a prepared maker comment.

faq.question: Does this skill submit my product to Product Hunt?
faq.answer: No. It helps you prepare assets, copy, timing, and engagement plans.

faq.question: Can it create gallery images?
faq.answer: It includes optional image prompts and inference.sh CLI examples. You must review outputs before using them.

faq.question: Does it guarantee a top Product Hunt ranking?
faq.answer: No. It improves preparation, but rankings depend on product fit, timing, audience, and engagement.

faq.question: What Product Hunt specs does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers taglines, descriptions, gallery images, topics, makers, links, timing, and maker comments.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Should I run the install command automatically?
faq.answer: No. Review installation steps and verify downloads before running external commands.
